item_title: Russia's invasion of Ukraine boosted European investments in dual-use tech like autonomous drones, rockets for satellites, and more
item_description: Aggi Cantrill / Bloomberg:  — European tech companies that work with the defense industry, long an investment taboo for many venture capital firms, are drawing record amounts of funding in the wake of Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
